text: Power Engineering and Engineering Thermophysics is an engineering discipline centered around "the generation, conversion, transmission and efficient utilization of energy". From small-scale household air conditioners for cooling and heating, to large-scale steam turbines for power generation in power plants, rocket engines for propulsion, and even battery thermal management in electric vehicles, all of these fall within its research scope. It is the "housekeeper of energy and power", not only addressing the issues of "how to efficiently generate heat and electricity", but also tackling "how to reduce energy consumption and lower emissions". It is the "energy foundation" that supports the operation of modern society.
